Name: Holiday Rug Club for Farmers
Author: AmuTsukiyomi
Description:
I decided to split up my rugs into multiple mods, because otherwise I'd never finish them.... I even made more as I was putting this together.  It's practically a running joke by this point.  Yes, I know about the thing with the doormats, no I'm not fixing it.

As always, this requires a LOT of mods if you want to be able to place them all over the everywhere.  If you're just sprucing up the inside of the farmhouse, you only need the first three.

SMAPI
PyTK
Custom Furniture
Entoarox Framework (optional)
Furniture Anywhere (optional)
Custom Furniture Anywhere (optional; be aware that using this can cause weird issues, but might not)

[color=#8e7cc3][size=3][b]Unlike my other mods that require Custom Furniture, this does NOT go into the furniture folder inside.  Treat this like any other Content pack; just drop into the mods folder.[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#cc0000][b]ASK TO USE MY SPRITES for other stuff, otherwise the answer is a default [i][u]ABSOLUTELY NO.[/u][/i][/b][/color]

Manifest.Description: Looks and feels just like the real thing, but more festive!
